title: How Culturally Aware Are Vision-Language Models?
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge and accurate captioning of cultural concepts, including mythological figures, religious symbols, and rituals, through a proposed metric called the Cultural Awareness Score (CAS).
findings: All tested vision-language models demonstrated low cultural awareness, with the highest scores being only 36% (Gemini Pro Vision). Models were most inaccurate and prone to hallucination when captioning images of cultural and religious signs and symbols, while performing better on real-life photographs of cultural practices like traditional dance (e.g., Kathakali).
